title: To Purify or Not to Purify: Entanglement Purification under Input Fidelity Asymmetry in Quantum Networks
summary: Entanglement purification with two entangled resource pairs is widely employed in the literature on quantum repeater networks to counteract fidelity degradation introduced by noisy quantum memories and entanglement swapping across multiple hops. Standard purification protocols assume both resource pairs carry identical fidelity. In practice, entanglement generation is stochastic, the two resource pairs are heralded at different times, and so the first pair decoheres in memory while the second is being generated.
